The connection closed or failed. Check the network, Bluetooth and pairing code.

Bluetooth: Pair two Android devices in system settings. One waits; the other selects it and enters the code shown in this app. Standard iPhone classic Bluetooth messaging is not supported.

LAN: Join the same Wi-Fi or hotspot. One waits; the other enters its address and code. Router client isolation can prevent communication.

An ongoing notification is shown while waiting or connected. Navigation, Home and screen lock do not deliberately disconnect. Choose Disconnect and stop to end the session. Force stop, network or Bluetooth loss and power restrictions can interrupt it; offline delivery is unavailable. Keeping a session active uses more battery.

Messages use a pairing code and AES-256-GCM with no cloud server. The protocol has not been independently audited. The code and last 100 messages stay in memory and are cleared when the service ends. Only transport, last LAN address and notification options are saved.
